items.q: How is this different from Upwork or a VA agency?
items.a: Marketplaces sell you hours from someone juggling several clients. We place one dedicated, full-time person, recruited for your specific role. With Direct Hire you contract them directly, and with Managed Staffing we employ them. We are not a virtual assistant marketplace and we are not a staffing agency that disappears after the invoice clears.

Talent salaries start at $1,600 a month. Handoff's fees depend on the model you choose, Direct Hire or Managed Staffing, and both carry a one-time placement fee of 25% of first-year salary, typically $4,500 to $6,500. We quote the exact number on the first call once we know the role.

items.q: We are not ready to hire someone full time.
items.a: Then we are not your fit yet, and we will say so rather than sell you something that will not work. Handoff exists for companies committing to a real hire who can own an area of the business.

items.q: What if the person does not work out?
items.a: If your hire doesn't work out within 90 days, we replace them at no cost. Under Managed Staffing we own performance management, so a problem is ours to fix, not another hiring cycle for you to run.
Same time zone as your team, genuinely client-ready English, and a professional culture that fits how US companies actually work. Our people join your standups, talk to your customers, and stay.

items.q: Will they really be part of my team?
items.a: That is the entire job. Placing someone is the easy half. We build the environment around them, which is why our people stay and why you stop paying to re-hire the same role.
